errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse listet die Länder in absteigender Reihenfolge der Gesamtausgaben im Verhältnis zum BIP auf

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nach der Gesamtgröße der Ausgaben im Jahr 2021 sortiert
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted by the total size of expenditures in 2021; the order is alphabetical by country name.
The description does not mention that the black vertical line above each bar represents 1.5% above the reference value of 2021.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates government expenditures as a percentage of GDP for various European countries.
The description does not mention the linear scale of the horizontal axis or its intervals (0.5).
The description does not highlight that Poland, Estonia, and Latvia have the highest green bars, reaching approximately 3.5% of GDP.
The description does not mention that Italy, Belgium, Slovenia, Luxembourg, and Spain have shorter green bars, all below 2% of GDP.
